extracted.intended_audience: companies, public-relations and investor-relations professionals submitting or managing press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and service features for creating and distributing press releases effectively via a commercial newswire (Business Wire), including regulatory disclosure, targeting, multimedia use, measurement, and event/tradeshow exposure. Focus is on preparing releases to meet disclosure obligations and maximize reach and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text news releases and regulatory filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire transmits full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use full-text format for maximum carriage; Business Wire originates hundreds of thousands of announcements each year and distributes them across its comprehensive network for broad capital and commercial market impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory disclosure compliance services (EDGAR, SEDAR, UK and European filings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe; in-house EDGAR team makes Business Wire the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector. Business Wire also offers Canadian SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings, along with disclosure fulfillment in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Sweden and Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your release is a regulated disclosure, use Business Wire’s dedicated regulatory filing services (EDGAR/SEDAR/European filings) to meet legal obligations and ensure appropriate regulatory distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry-segment targeting (200+ segments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire, AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire and SportsWire networks offer more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery to relevant audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate industry wire(s) to reach specialized journalists and stakeholders; precise targeting increases relevance and pickup among industry-specific outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue-specific circuits (CSR and Public Policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides services for issue-specific news such as corporate social responsibility and public policy with CSR Circuit and Public Policy Circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use issue-specific circuits when announcing CSR initiatives or policy-related news to reach audiences and outlets focused on those topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic market targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic markets include Hispanic, African and Asian American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose demographic-targeted distribution to reach ethnic and demographic media outlets and audiences when messaging is aimed at specific communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-text carriage via major global news organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire is the only commercial newswire that has full-text carriage provisions with Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones and ThomsonReuters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage Business Wire’s full-text carriage partnerships to maximize pickup and redistribution by major news agencies; ensure release formatting and content meet agency requirements for carriage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia distribution through Smart News Release platform
rubrics_metrics.description: Via Business Wire's exclusive Smart News Release platform, text news releases and multimedia content are posted online and distributed to key audiences via the Business Wire network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate multimedia (photos, video, other assets) using the Smart News Release format to enhance online presentation and audience engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo Smart News Release placement (Yahoo! Finance, AP photo network, newspapers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo Smart News Releases are posted directly to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers in the US via the Associated Press photo network and posted to community and industry-based websites. Smart News Release also offers photo distribution to newspapers and media in the UK, Europe and Asia via leading photo agency partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include high-quality photos and use Photo Smart News Release to achieve targeted photo placement on finance portals, AP photo wire, and international newspaper/photo-agency networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement and monitoring (NewsTrak analytics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's suite of measurement and monitoring services, NewsTrak, provides news release distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NewsTrak and related measurement tools to evaluate distribution, viewership, media pickup, and reputation impact; tailor future releases based on these analytics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tradeshow & conference partnerships and Official Wire status
rubrics_metrics.description: Tradeshow and conference division works with leading industry shows and financial conferences, including having Official Wire status at dozens of them, providing integrated communications tools and unique additional exposure for members' news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate press releases with tradeshow/official-wire participation to gain additional visibility at events and conferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local newsrooms, personalized customer service, and fast turnaround
rubrics_metrics.description: With more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire, Business Wire provides better local support with fast turnaround of your news releases and greater accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with local Business Wire newsrooms for region-specific support and faster processing to improve accuracy and timeliness of distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release SEO and optimization services
rubrics_metrics.description: Services and resources include SEO Tips & Tools, Press Release Optimization, EON: Enhanced Online News, and related SEO services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimize headlines, keywords, and online formatting using Business Wire’s SEO tools and services to improve search visibility and online discovery of releases.
